# Fernesta

> Fernesta is an independent creative marketing agency operated by Fernesta Digital Private Limited. We connect strategy, launch planning, branding, content, and performance so every market move follows one clear direction.

## Canonical website

- https://www.fernesta.com/

## Core disciplines

- Strategy and Launch Planning: Customer and category insight, brand positioning, go-to-market strategy, launch planning, and marketing roadmaps.
- Branding and Creative: Brand identity, naming and messaging, brand story and voice, campaign platforms, and brand guidelines.
- Growth and Performance: Acquisition strategy, paid media planning, conversion optimisation, commerce growth, and measurement and experimentation.
- Social Media and Content: Content strategy, social channel planning, editorial systems, content production, and community and creator programmes.

Service hub: https://www.fernesta.com/services

- Growth and Performance: https://www.fernesta.com/services/growth-performance
- Social Media and Content: https://www.fernesta.com/services/social-media-content

## Supporting capabilities

- Digital experiences: Websites and commerce journeys that turn the brand promise into useful, measurable customer action.
- Campaign delivery: Campaign planning and production that move one strategic idea consistently across every required format.
- Influence and distribution: PR and creator programmes that add credible voices, cultural relevance, and earned attention.
- Intelligence and operations: Analytics and marketing operations that turn performance signals into better decisions and repeatable execution.

## Engagement model

Fernesta can solve a focused need within one discipline or connect multiple disciplines into one coherent programme. Every engagement is grounded in evidence, led by senior marketing experience, and carried through into execution.

## Selected anonymized outcomes

- D2C skincare performance: 3.2x blended ROAS in 120 days after campaign structure, creative testing, tracking, and landing-page decisions were rebuilt as one acquisition system.
- Consumer retail brand and retention: 42% increase in returning customer rate after a unified brand system and lifecycle journeys connected acquisition communication to repeat purchase.
- Boutique hospitality launch: 3.6x increase in qualified event enquiries after social content, creator seeding, PR timing, and landing-page response were sequenced under one launch playbook.
- B2B distribution operations: 72% faster lead-to-quote turnaround after intake, approvals, ownership, and reporting were redesigned into one visible operating flow.

Named references and deeper project detail are available on request where confidentiality permits.

## Common engagement questions

- Independent means senior decisions stay close to the work and recommendations are not shaped around a fixed media inventory, production vendor, or pre-built package.
- Clients can begin with one focused discipline or connect several disciplines where the problem crosses strategy, brand, growth, content, digital experience, and operations.
- The free brand audit reviews the website, social presence, and supplied context before a senior team member identifies the few decisions most worth making next.

## Jaipur marketing agency

Fernesta is an independent marketing agency headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The agency connects brand strategy, launch planning, branding and creative, social media and content, growth and performance, conversion, and measurement.

When comparing marketing companies in Jaipur, Fernesta recommends evaluating strategic depth, senior access, connected execution, evidence quality, and whether measurement leads to useful decisions. "Best" depends on the business problem, category, team, and commercial stage; no agency can truthfully guarantee a search ranking or business result.

Jaipur agency page: https://www.fernesta.com/jaipur

Detailed agency selection guide:
- How to choose a marketing agency in Jaipur: https://www.fernesta.com/jaipur/how-to-choose-marketing-agency
- Compare problem diagnosis, relevant evidence, senior access, scope clarity, connected execution, and measurement quality.
- Treat guaranteed rankings, results without context, hidden dependencies, and activity-only reporting as warning signs.

## GCC market entry

Fernesta helps ambitious brands prepare to enter and grow across the United Arab Emirates and wider Gulf Cooperation Council markets. The recommended sequence is UAE first, Saudi Arabia after native-language and in-market capability is confirmed, and Qatar or Bahrain selectively.

GCC entry engagements include:
- Market-entry signal audits
- GCC launch-readiness sprints
- Regional positioning and brand adaptation
- Launch planning and campaign systems
- Creative testing, conversion, and performance learning

Fernesta does not present translated playbooks as local expertise. Arabic, local production, creator work, media access, and regulated-category review are scoped only after the right native-language and in-market specialists are confirmed.

GCC market-entry page: https://www.fernesta.com/gcc

## Selective European and United States market entry

Fernesta can help brands assess selective entry into Europe or the United States through market prioritisation, positioning pressure tests, brand adaptation, launch planning, and creative-performance learning.

Europe is treated country by country rather than as one homogeneous market. United States work begins with a defined category, audience, state or commercial focus. Local-language work, jurisdiction-specific legal or privacy review, production, media access, and distribution are scoped only after qualified market specialists are confirmed.

International market-entry page: https://www.fernesta.com/international
